headline: Executive order aimed at stopping the hoarding of health and medical supplies needed to respond to COVID-19.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal action to prevent people or businesses from hoarding health and medical resources during the spread of COVID-19. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, supplies covered, and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and individuals holding large amounts of medical supplies
who_it_affects.how: They may face federal limits on stockpiling health and medical resources beyond what they need.

who_it_affects.group: Hospitals, health care workers, and patients
who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to keep scarce medical supplies available for the COVID-19 response.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 23, 2020; no separate start date is given in the available information.
